description: Apply the grouping a completed start_auto_clustering job proposed: creates the clusters it named and moves the tracked queries into them, as the job's mode said. Cluster names are lower-cased like create_clusters, and a proposed name that matches an existing cluster reuses it instead of creating a second one. Show the proposal (get_job) to the user first. Pass a fresh requestId and reuse it if you retry, so a retry never applies twice.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key, 8-255 printable characters. Reuse it only to retry this same call.

name: apply_auto_clustering
title: Apply a proposed clustering
